full_judgment: In the decision reported in 33 DLR (AD) 58 Fazle Munim J as his Lordship was then, (with him Kamaluddin Hossain CJ and KM Subhan J) held that a worker who has not been dismissed in the course of an industrial dispute nor dismissal has led to such a dispute is not entitled to maintain an application before the Labour Court under Section 34 of the said Ordinance, But the other two learned Judges, Ruhul Islam J. and Badrul Haider Chowdhury, J, as their Lordships were then, held that section 34 puts no such limitation in the filing of an application by a 'worker' or 'workman' before the Labour Court for the enforcement of his right guaranteed of secured under any law.
